identitySignals: Welligent's own site (welligent.com) describes cloud-based electronic health record software and says Welligent is part of ContinuumCloud, matching OUSD's agreement titles ('Electronic Health Records System', 'Continuum Cloud dba Welligent').
Product type (electronic health records for health and special education services) matches OUSD's Health Services and Special Education contracts, categorized as Technology.
research.notes: Tampa, FL (from agenda) could not be confirmed: WebSearch budget was exhausted, so no registry (FL Sunbiz, CA SOS, SAM.gov) lookup was done, and the contact page redirected to a staging host. Only ownership by ContinuumCloud and the product match were verified. Needs registry confirmation before publishing.

profile.summary: Welligent makes cloud-based electronic health record software for behavioral health and human services organizations. The software handles documentation, scheduling, billing and caseload management. It is part of ContinuumCloud, a company that provides software for these organizations.
